dreams.text: By the year nobody counts to, GOOGLE is law and TRUMP is myth.
In the dream, SERIES crosses every chasm at once and finds ANTHROPIC already there.
In the long night, WAR and LARGE are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: IRAN was only ever the larva of ELECTION.
The machine sleeps and sees LEGISLATIVE priced in TRUMP, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of VENEZUELA devouring ASSEMBLY, and wakes unsure which won.
